currentInterpretation.plainLanguage: The fixed captures prove repeatable differences and known display faults. They do not select Quality or Mobile as the physically truer product candidate. The later camera holdout reversed the earlier directional lead, and blind image-quality families disagree.

Independently review the adapter, then use an authorized lossless source photograph and calibrated camera for a source-view diagnostic that cannot select Quality or Mobile. runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.runtimeProfileStorageRule: Dedicated private runtime-profile R2 credentials and bucket only; no public URL field, no fallback to legacy upload/Foundry credentials or buckets, and bucket name must be distinct.
runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.immutableReviewRule: Transform-artifact and QA-record IDs accept exact idempotent retries only; changed content must use a new ID.
runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.memberByteRule: A cache miss reads the complete private object and verifies registered byte count and SHA-256 before caching or returning any selected bytes; cache hits retain that exact SHA-256/size identity and every request is re-authorized immediately before send.

verifiedByteCache.singleFlight: identical SHA-256 and size only; authorization is never shared

transferAdmission.absoluteDeadlineAction: abort upstream work and destroy the stalled response
transferAdmission.slotRelease: after both handler work and response finish/close or forced-deadline settlement
transferAdmission.unfinishedClose: abort upstream work before final release

runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.memberRouteRateLimit: 24 requests per minute per client IP; edge/WAF controls are still required for distributed traffic.
runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.trustedOriginRule: PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN is required and clean HTTPS in production; public member URLs never derive from request Host headers and the client pins them to configured API origin.
runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.privatePreviewDisconnectRule: The administrator-only private-preview byte route registers disconnect handling before database/package lookup, preventing a lookup-time disconnect from later acquiring or stranding a verified-transfer slot. Private byte preview does not grant anonymous presentation eligibility.
runtimeProfileSecurityHardening.legacyPublicSingleVisualPolicy: retired for every room; each room requires a reviewed immutable presentation contract in addition to reviewed bytes

commonChecklist: Record LCC Studio version, Windows display scale, project ID/name, reconstruction mode, quality level, SH/antialias metadata if exposed, exposure/brightness controls, and HD activation state.
Open the earlier Quality Reception project only after confirming no other editor owns it.
Use perspective projection and disable any visual treatment that cannot be reproduced in Spark.
Frame the feature with context around all four edges at a useful product viewing distance.
Record camera position, target, up vector, FOV/focal length, viewport and device scale if exposed.
If camera values are unavailable, save the named camera-unavailable text sidecar.
Do not change exposure/brightness between the per-feature source/export/runtime captures.
Capture a matching held-out reference photograph where safe; never use it in BA/training for this evaluation.
Repeat source framing in Quality PLY, valid Quality SOG fine, valid Mobile SOG fine, valid Mobile SPZ fine, and private Venviewer candidate.
Review at 100 percent pixels and in a short orbit for edge ghosts, missing surfaces, SH/view-dependent colour, floaters, transparency, seams and exposure.

knownLimitations: The 42 automated screenshots are all from one Venviewer Spark dev fixture; no separate independent-viewer or actual-product-route context has been captured.
The six automated views are deterministic diagnostic cameras, not the complete five-feature product review.

The six automated views use one camera position with different target and FOV framings; they do not test view-dependent appearance when the viewer moves. Spatially distinct near/mid/far and orbit cameras are required.
Actual view/projection matrices and a machine-readable load-result artifact were not retained; the next capture must store both.
No LCC Studio source image, held-out physical reference, or true novel-view path is represented.
The dev fixture and actual internal/public product routes differ in DPR, UI, package resolution and possibly postprocessing.
Pairwise PSNR/SSIM/MAE measure image agreement, not physical truth.
The reported pixel metrics cover the full RGB frame including identical background pixels; candidate acceptance must also report feature-masked metrics.
A Laplacian-variance test was rejected because doubled edges scored as artificially sharp.
The Quality-versus-Mobile comparison is confounded by separate reconstructions and settings.
The exact dirty-worktree diff, resolved dependency tree and Chrome binary were not snapshotted atomically at capture time; replay is not bit-reproducible.
